dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal section toward the visible posterior region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-medium slate grey median pixel intensity across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey shading along the longitudinal axis, particularly in the lower dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between the baseline grey pigment and the slightly darker longitudinal shading.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct, elongated high-contrast white mark on the left lateral-dorsal plane; smaller, lower-contrast punctate light spots scattered in the same quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent elongated white linear mark on the left lateral-dorsal surface.
